messages:
samir: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need owners & tickets for the cache-thundering postmortem (03/18). Goal: sign-offs on remediation tasks + handoff checklist by EOD Tue. Remediation window target: complete by 2025-04-07.
samir: Initial action items (please claim):
• owner + jira for short-term throttle/guardrails
• owner + jira for oncall playbook updates and runbook examples
• owner + jira for alert dedup & grouping rules
• owner + jira for telemetry gaps (missing metrics that would have detected pattern earlier)
• owner + jira for long-term cache architecture hardening (spike)

julia: I'll take short-term throttle/guardrails. Making ticket now.
julia: created INF-1300 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1300 — assigned to me. ETA 2025-03-28. Will include quick rollback steps and a canary plan.

trung: I'll own alert dedup/grouping. Opening INF-1301 and will add a draft of new rule sets for review. Need @ameen to confirm alert destinations.
ameen: On it for alert destinations. INF-1301 looks good; I'll check the current Pager routing and suggest suppression windows for cache-warmup.
eva: I'll do the runbook and post-incident checklists. INF-1302 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1302 — pairing with @product-bot for runbook template. ETA 2025-03-30.

product-bot: Reminder: runbook templates require acceptance criteria and customer-facing impact section. See docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks

samir: RACI (proposal):
• Short-term guardrails — R: julia, A: infra eng lead, C: runtime team, I: oncall
• Runbook/playbook — R: eva, A: SRE lead, C: support, I: product
• Alert grouping — R: trung, A: SRE lead, C: alert-ingest, I: oncall
• Telemetry gaps spike — R: ame en, A: observability eng, C: infra, I: product
• Long-term hardening spike — R: samir, A: eng manager, C: research, I: security

trung: Small ask re: handoff — for any ticket that moves to platform maintenance, include a maintenance checklist with owner transfer step and signal to flip the owner. I'll add a checklist PR template to INF-1301.

julia: Pasted rollback snippet into INF-1300:
```
# disable aggressive prefetch
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.api/redwood/v1/flags/prefetch -d '{"value":false}'
# scale down prefetch workers
kubectl scale deployment prefetch-workers --replicas=1 -n ded-prod
```

eva: For runbook acceptance criteria:
• steps to detect issue in <5m with dashboard link
• defined outrigger mitigation steps (prefetch off, throttle on)
• post-mitigation verification queries
• owner and SLAs for follow-up actions
I'll add those to INF-1302.

nameen: Telemetry spike: INF-1303 opened https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1303 to instrument per-prefix miss ratio, prefetch queue length, and prefix-hotspot heatmap. ETA for proposal: 2025-04-04.

samir: Also opened INF-1304 for recurrence analysis — this is the 3rd similar incident in ~10 weeks. Need someone to lead RCA on recurrence patterns and systemic mitigations.

eva: I'll own the recurrence RCA as a follow-on to runbook work. INF-1304 assigned to me, ETA 2025-04-07 for initial analysis.

ops-bot: Poll: remediation sync — Tue 11:00am PST or Wed 2:00pm PST. Vote with :thumbsup: or :hand:.

trung: voted :thumbsup: for Tue 11.
julia: Tue 11 works.
ameen: Wed 2 preferred but can make Tue 11 if needed.

samir: Let's do Tue 11 then. Agenda: quick ticket rundown (INF-1300..INF-1304), canary plans, ownership handoffs.

eva: Quick note about documentation handoff: when tickets go to "platform-maintenance" status, include a link to the console-flag and to the runbook section. That prevents losing context during owner rotation.

trung: On acceptance criteria: please add measurable success criteria (e.g., reduce prefix-miss spike occurrences by 80% in 30 days) and monitor duration threshold for alerts. I'll add a monitoring objective to INF-1301.

julia: Also proposing a temporary mitigation: rate-limit heavy upstream clients for 72h post-deploy while we validate eviction changes. I'll add this as a subtask on INF-1300.

samir: Final asks: everyone add explicit acceptance criteria in their Jira ticket and ping me when items are ready for review. If anyone needs extra capacity, flag it in the ticket and we'll reassign. Thanks all.
